tasks.behavior: A merchant invites team members by email and manages their roles
acceptance: Invites are single use, hashed, bound to the invited email and expire in 7 days; the invited user accepts at /invite/<token> signed in with that verified email
An Admin changes roles and stores with a fresh sign-in (D-63) and removes members; a member leaves; the last Admin can't leave or be demoted
The Team page lists members and invites
The app hides pages a role can't use
notes:
2026-10-25 review fail by reviewer: Backend security holds: SHA-256 only, token dropped from outbox on send/skip/give-up (mutation-tested), accept bound to Privy login email under FOR UPDATE, owner untouchable, team routes Admin-only, token never logged (r.Pattern) or returned, Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin, migration Up/Down passes TestMigrationsRollBackAndReapply. Backend, notify and web unit tests pass.
BLOCKING 1: apps/web/src/screens/invoices/invoices-screen.tsx:12, invoice-screen.tsx:15, new-invoice-screen.tsx:36 (+68 billing, +72 clients) still poll GET /balances (money.read) for a Developer, whose first page is Invoices: 403 every 15 s, list amounts stay skeletons (invoice-amount.tsx:16), and New invoice shows the tokens-failed alert, so a Developer cannot create an invoice. Breaks R-139 'hides the pages, links and polls a role can't use'; docs/web/architecture.md:46 claims otherwise. team.spec.ts misses it because mockApi answers balances 200 for every role.
BLOCKING 2: apps/web/src/features/team/components/member-actions.tsx:45-52: role/stores state is seeded once from props and reset on close from the pre-refetch member, so after a successful change, reopening Change role shows the old role and stores, and Save reverts the change. Reset the state on open instead.
NON-BLOCKING: (a) team-api.ts:96-107 / accept-invite.tsx:37-39: unwrap() resolves before the onQueryStarted signUp refetch, so /app can render the stale me (onboardedAt null for a new invitee) and bounce to /app/onboarding; the comment 'read again before the app opens it' is wrong; await the refetch before router.push. (b) team/invites.go: Accept locks the invite row, then needs FOR KEY SHARE on the profile (profile_members FK), while Invite holds the profile FOR UPDATE and then updates the same open invite: a re-invite racing its accept deadlocks (one 500). Lock the profile first in Accept. (c) members.go:90: removing or demoting an Admin leaves their open invites valid, so a removed Admin who invited an address they control can rejoin within 7 days; consider revoking by invited_by, or record a decision. (d) app-nav.ts:33-38: pageAllowed reads only APP_NAV[kind] and MENU_PAGES, so /app/jobs is open to a merchant Developer or Finance and polls /jobs (403); /app/stores/new is open to Finance without stores.write. (e) docs/web/architecture.md:90: the Team edge bullet sits between 'Two more edges lead to stores' and its sub-bullets, which now nest under Team. (f) D-84: the R-139 sentence 'An invite works once ... given up.' (PROJECT.md:191) and the apps/web/AGENTS.md intro sentence are 28 words. (g) Dead code: team.go:10 InviteFor is unused (the expiry is the migration DEFAULT); INVITE_COPY.signInTitle and PERMISSIONS.invoicesWrite are unused. (h) 'Stores deleted since the invite are left out' (invites.go:120, api.md, openapi) handles a case that can't happen: stores have no delete. (i) Tests: no 403 case for Developer or Finance on the team write routes, no cross-profile revoke or remove case, and no test of the give-up token drop. Acceptable, because routes.go puts auth.Team on every team route. (j) An Admin removing or demoting themselves keeps stale /v1/me permissions, so the Team page shows a load error until reload. (k) The invite dialog defaults to Admin, the widest role. (l) apps/web/test-results/.last-run.json was left from the Playwright run.

2026-10-25 review pass by reviewer: Re-review after fixes. Both blocking findings are fixed.
(1) The invoice pages take symbols and decimals from GET /tokens, which lists the same enabled tokens as balances and which every role reads. New invoice skips billing details without billing.read and clients without clients.read. team.spec now answers 403 to any read the role lacks, records it, and asserts none for a Developer on Invoices and New invoice.
(2) member-actions.tsx resets the Change role form from the current member before it opens.
The earlier non-blocking items are fixed:
- AcceptInvite awaits me.refetch() before saving the profile and opening /app.
- Accept locks the profile row before the invite, the same order as Invite and SetMember.
- RemoveMember, Leave and SetMember away from Admin revoke the member's open invites. A mutation removing that revoke fails TestTeamInvitesAndRoles.
- pageAllowed checks every NAV item and MENU_PAGES by the longest href. New store needs stores.write, and Add store hides without it.
- The docs order and sentence lengths are fixed, and the dead code is gone. The invite dialog defaults to Developer.
Reran the backend team, members, routes, notify and auth tests, TestMigrationsRollBackAndReapply and web vitest (143/143): all pass.
NON-BLOCKING:
(a) members.go:100 and invites.go:46: an invite sent at the moment its Admin is removed or demoted can survive. RemoveMember takes no profile lock, and Invite checks the inviter's access outside its transaction. Fix: lock the profile in RemoveMember and recheck the inviter inside Invite's transaction.
(b) docs/web/architecture.md:46 still says app-nav.ts hides the polls. The gating sits in app-shell, command-menu and notifications-menu through can(), and the invoice pages read /tokens.
(c) No regression check for reopening Change role after a save (team.spec could reopen once), and the demotion path of the invite revoke has no test.
(d) Carried over: self-demotion keeps stale /v1/me permissions until reload, the give-up token drop is untested, and apps/web/test-results/.last-run.json is still present.

2026-10-25 review pass by reviewer: Re-review of the last three changes. The removal race is closed: RemoveMember (and so Leave) takes lockMerchant first, and Invite checks again under the profile lock that the inviter is the owner or an Admin, else 403. Removal, demotion and an invite from that member now run one after the other, and a revoke sees an invite committed before it. docs/web/architecture.md:46-47 now matches the code. team.spec reopens Change role after a save and expects Admin. The duplicate Cancel name is gone: the close icon uses the kit's Close. Reran the backend team, members and routes tests, the notify tests and web vitest (143/143): all pass.
NON-BLOCKING:
(a) invites.go: the inviter check names the role 'admin' in SQL instead of asking auth's map for the team permission. It matches today, but D-93 keeps who-may-do-what in that one map.
(b) RemoveMember and Leave now answer 409 not_merchant on a personal or freelancer profile, which only its owner reaches (it was 422 or 404). The openapi DELETE /members and POST /leave responses don't list 409.
(c) Carried over: self-demotion keeps stale /v1/me permissions until reload, the give-up token drop is untested, and apps/web/test-results/.last-run.json is still present.

2026-10-25 review pass by reviewer: Re-review of the four open items; all four are closed. (1) Invite reads the inviter's role under the profile lock and asks auth.Access{Role}.Can(auth.Team), so the role name is gone from SQL. SetMember revokes invites when the new role lacks team. TestInviteChecksTheInviterAgain calls Invite without the route guard, and a mutation that turns the check off makes it fail. (2) openapi removeMember and leaveTeam list 409 NotMerchant, and api.md names the locking operations and the second inviter check. (3) setMember and removeMember read /v1/me again with subscribe: false, so no subscription is left behind. team-api.test.ts checks the third request is /v1/me and the cache holds the new permissions. (4) The notify test gives up on one invite and expects failed_at with no token. Reran internal/team, notify, the httpapi team, members and routes tests, and web vitest (144/144): all pass. NON-BLOCKING: docs/backend/api.md:207 says every invite and member change on a personal or freelancer profile is 409, but DELETE /invites/{inviteId} takes no profile lock and answers 404 invite_not_found there. Only that profile's owner can reach it.
